messages:
brie: Quick thought: introduce explicit component-scope bindings so a route can reference an embedder, generator, and reranker independently. This would let us do mixed-version rollouts (e.g., new embedder + old generator) without global churn.

omar: Sounds useful. Main risk is resolver semantics and client caching. We should return a resolved mapping + a binding_version to force re-resolve on change.

liu: Schema idea (short): components:{embedder: 'rwd-emb-v3', generator: 'rwd-gen-v2'} + per_component.deprecation and compatibility ranges. Keep default behavior additive so existing route/global bindings still work.

pat: Ops notes: need migration tooling to backfill route components, a dry-run mode, and a canary flow: 5% traffic, 30m, monitor latency/errors/eval. Auto-fallback if thresholds breach.

brie: Also propose a stability_hint (0-1) per component to let optimizer prefer safer combos. And allow tenant overrides but require a tenant opt-in window when a global component is deprecated.

omar: For headers: X-Rwd-Resolved-Models: embedder=rwd-emb-v3;generator=rwd-gen-v2;binding-v=20250415. SDKs re-resolve if binding-v changes. Mobile SDKs must also respect cache TTL shorter than binding window.

liu: Edge-case: quantized variant families. Add a field family: "precision": "q4_0" so resolver can pick capacity-compatible variants.

pat: CLI surfaces: redwoodctl bind --scope {global|route|component} --route /search --component generator=rwd-gen-v2 and redwoodctl migrate-bindings --dry-run. Ops will own the migration runbook.

brie: I'll open a brief RFC with schema examples, resolver response proto, and a migration checklist. Please drop short comments in the PR.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary started for /search components {embedder:rwd-emb-v3, generator:rwd-gen-v2} at 5%. id=canary-3791. Metrics collector: latency, errors, eval-run queued.

omar: Action items: brie PR + schema, liu compatibility rules + default windows, pat runbook + CLI RFC, SDK teams update resolver behavior.

brie: Thanks — aim to merge schema draft next week if no major objections. :thumbsup:
